messages:
elaine: quick FYI 0min: Acme signed LOE asking for SSO + provisioning for pilot. they want a firm start week but our capacity is tight.

elaine: two clear paths: (A) SAML-only pilot + manual onboarding (B) ship SAML+SCIM auto-provisioning but delay pilot start. need product/eng input.

devin: rough estimate: SAML-only is 1 sprint. SCIM minimal (create/update users + basic auth) is ~3w including infra + e2e.

omar: compliance note: Acme expects audit trails for provisioning actions. even minimal SCIM needs logging hooks (~2d).

sandra: customer POV: manual provisioning will increase ops friction; their adoption metric is "seat population within 48h". if we can't hit that, pilot risk rises.

chris: ops workaround: offer a managed onboarding service for initial pilot cohort (we run provisioning script). reduces engineering urgency.

elaine: tradeoff seems reasonable: ops-frontload vs delayed pilot. any blockers on SAML-only from security?

omar: SAML-only is straightforward. Risks: we have to ensure session/relay-state handling for multi-tenant flows. low effort.

jonah: timeline scenarios: SAML-only + ops runbook -> pilot in 2w, automation ready by v1 (+6w). SAML+SCIM -> pilot in 5w with automation included.

devin: note: shipping minimal SCIM without full regression coverage likely increases oncall load. support team flagged that.

sandra: can we stage pilot (single Acme team first) to reduce blast radius? that helps with manual ops.

elaine: proposal: do SAML-only pilot, ops-assisted onboarding, commit to SCIM+audit logs for v1. set milestones: pilot start +2w, v1 GA +8w.

chris: i'll own runbook & oncall rota for first 4 weeks, publish in #support.

sandra: i'll update Acme, set expectations on provisioning SLA and confirm they accept manual onboarding for pilot.

devin: i'll add tasks to the PRD + sprint board and flag SCIM for v1. will add feature flag for quick rollback.

omar: QA will plan a staged rollout and extra validation around audit events.

elaine: next actions:
- sandra: update Acme (today)
- chris: publish runbook (48h)
- devin: PRD + backlog updates (EOD)
- calendar-bot: create milestone check-in

calendar-bot: "Event created: Pilot scope check-in 0: Friday 10:00"

elaine: marking this resolved unless Acme pushes for automation before pilot start. :thumbsup:
